newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine unemployment rises to 277,468 in October.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine unemployment rises to 277,468 in October.

text.p: Registered unemployment in Ukraine rose to 277,468 at the end of October from 257,665 at the end of September, the Statistics Ministy said on Monday.
NOTE - Official Ukrainian information tends to understate unemployment levels.
Ukrainian Labor Minister Mykola Biloblodsky said last month that registered unemployment stood at about 0.9 percent of the workforce.
The minister also said the real unemployment stood at about 3.5 million. Officials estimate the Ukrainian workforce at about 26 million.
The government forecasts registered unemployment will rise to 1.3 million by the end of next year.
